incident_report.incident: Over the final 100 Metres shifted out abruptly, resulting in its rider having to stop riding and straighten.  A warning was placed on the racing manners of MEGA MASTERMIND.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Leaving the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid GRAND TURBO when that runner was checked.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Bumped at the start.  Near the 350 Metres blundered and approaching the 300 Metres lay in when having difficulty obtaining clear running when positioned close to ROBOT STAR.

Leaving the 1100 Metres ROBOT STAR and FORZA TORO made contact due to both runners shifting ground slightly.  A short distance later ROBOT STAR then commenced to race keenly and was checked when crowded between LUCKY SECRET which gave ground and then shifted out when taken wider by WINNING DIAMOND (M L Yeung) and FORZA TORO (H Bowman) which shifted in slightly.  H Bowman was reprimanded and advised to ensure he leaves sufficient racing room to runners to his inside.  M L Yeung was advised to exercise more care.  Near the 50 Metres was checked to avoid MEGA MASTERMIND (B Avdulla) which shifted out abruptly before being corrected by its rider.  B Avdulla was severely reprimanded and advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to stop riding and straighten his mounts sooner than what he did on this occasion.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by WINNING DIAMOND which shifted out.  Leaving the 1100 Metres FORZA TORO and ROBOT STAR made contact due to both runners shifting ground slightly.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Jumped awkwardly and shortly after the start became unbalanced when bumped by GRAND TURBO.
Shifted out on jumping and was bumped.

Leaving the 1100 Metres made contact with BUCEPHALAS due to both runners shifting ground.  After being crossed by BUCEPHALAS approaching the 800 Metres raced keenly and was steadied to avoid BUCEPHALAS.  Over the concluding stages had difficulty obtaining clear running when positioned close to ROBOT STAR when that runner was checked.

M L Yeung stated that he was instructed to settle the horse where comfortable.  He added that when his mount jumped well and the early stages of the race were run slightly outside of standard time he was able to hold an on-pace position without having to pressure his mount to do so.

Bumped at the start.  Leaving the 1100 Metres made contact with MATSU VICTOR due to both runners shifting ground.  K C Leung stated that after holding an on-pace position his mount gave ground noticeably near the 200 Metres but could offer no excuse for the performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

D B McMonagle stated that with the early stages of the event being run slightly outside of standard time his mount finished the race off in a one-paced manner when it found it difficult to make up ground from back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

On jumping was bumped by THE ABSOLUTE which shifted out.  As a result GRAND TURBO shifted out and made contact with FIGHTING MACHINE.  Near the 800 Metres was checked to avoid LUCKY SECRET when racing tight to the inside of LUCKY SECRET which gave ground. R Kingscote was warned in relation to using his whip on a horse which was clearly out of contention.

Leaving the 1100 Metres was steadied when crowded between WINNING DIAMOND which shifted out slightly and MATSU VICTOR (C Y Ho) which, after making contact with BUCEPHALAS, then shifted in and away from that runner.  C Y Ho was advised to exercise more care.  Near the 800 Metres, when racing keenly, lost ground when being checked to avoid MATSU VICTOR.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.  For some distance near the 900 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid LIGHTNESS OF BEING.  As a result PRESTIGE HALL shifted out and made contact with DAILY ACCLAIM near the 850 Metres.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Approaching the 600 Metres, when racing keenly, improved into a narrow run between GOOD FORTUNE and TOP THRONE.  Near the 600 Metres BABY SAKURA then made contact with GOOD FORTUNE on a number of occasions when TOP THRONE shifted out slightly.  J Orman stated that the intention was to hold a more forward position but when his mount jumped only fairly it settled further back than intended.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Leaving the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid ALSONSO when racing keenly.
Bumped and became unbalanced near the 600 Metres.
Had its right front plate refitted in the saddling stalls, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.
Jumped only fairly.  Over the concluding stages was eased and shifted to the inside of TOP THRONE to continue into clear running.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Raced keenly in the early stages.  Leaving the 900 Metres got its head up when being steadied to avoid BABY SAKURA.
Jumped only fairly.  Bumped near the 850 Metres.  Over the final 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when attempting to improve between GOOD FORTUNE and THUNDER PRINCE.
Jumped only fairly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
H T Mo was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 3 consecutive strides passing the 200 Metres.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Noted to have lost its right hind plate at the barriers.  When unable to be replated REAL GENTLEMAN was withdrawn by order of the Stewards.

Withdrawn on 20.3.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (inappetence) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter FORZA LEADER.  Before being allowed to race again, NAVAS G will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start lost ground when badly crowded between PRESTIGE WIN which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider and GOLDEN CHAMP which was taken out by YOUNG EMPEROR.  After the race an endoscopic examination was conducted on CIRCUIT CHAMPION at the request of Trainer C S Shum.  The Veterinary Surgeon said this examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, CIRCUIT CHAMPION will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Lay in in the Home Straight.
Lay out when obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Near the 100 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the inside of KA YING ATTACK.

D B McMonagle stated that the horse enjoyed a comfortable run during the event but finished the race off only fairly when under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Kicked a rail leaving the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Z Purton stated that after improving into the event on the Home Turn his mount finished the race off only fairly in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
Shortly after the start became unbalanced when crowded between CIRCUIT CHAMPION and YOUNG EMPEROR which shifted out.

Shortly after the start shifted in despite the efforts of its rider, made contact with CIRCUIT CHAMPION and as a result became unbalanced.  When commencing to give ground near the 100 Metres was eased when racing in restricted room between LIFELINE EXPRESS and REFUSETOBEENGLISH which shifted in.

Near the 550 Metres was steadied when crowded between ISLAND BUDDY which shifted out slightly and ELEGANT LIFE (E C W Wong) which shifted in before being corrected by its rider.  Jockey Wong was reprimanded.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Leaving the 900 Metres was hampered when taken wider by HAPPY SHOOTER.  Near the 550 Metres shifted in and made contact with GOLD PATCH, resulting in its rider E C W Wong correcting his mount.  As a result ELEGANT LIFE shifted out abruptly and made the Home Turn wide.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
No report.
No report.
No report.

Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Near the 1100 Metres improved into a run when there was not sufficient room and then raced tight to the inside of GREAT SPIRIT before shifting in and away from that runner.  Leaving the 800 Metres was steadied when crowded between HAPPY SHOOTER which shifted in when racing keenly and EVERSTAR which shifted out when being steadied to avoid LUCKY PLUS.

In the early stages raced keenly.  Leaving the 900 Metres was shifted to the outside of GOLD PATCH and as a result made contact with ELEGANT LIFE which was taken wider.  Lay out making the Home Turn.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start was eased when crowded between ISLAND BUDDY and GREAT SPIRIT which shifted in.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by GREAT SPIRIT which shifted in.  Near the 1100 Metres was steadied when crowded by MASTER LUCKY (A Atzeni) which, after improving to the inside of GREAT SPIRIT when there was not sufficient room to do so, was then taken in by GREAT SPIRIT.  A Atzeni was reprimanded.  <26/3/2026 Additional Veterinary Report>  The Veterinary Surgeon reported that SHANDONG SPIRIT was lame in its left hind leg on the morning after racing.  Before being allowed to race again, SHANDONG SPIRIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Leaving the 800 Metres commenced to race keenly and was steadied to avoid LUCKY PLUS.  EVERSTAR continued to race keenly and lay out in the middle stages.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied to avoid GOLD PATCH and as a result became unbalanced.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.  Noted to have blood in the mouth after the race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

GALLANT DESIGN, which was fractious in the starting gates when the start was effected, jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  Approaching the 900 Metres improved to the inside of REZEKI when that runner shifted out whilst racing keenly.  A short distance later GALLANT DESIGN was then steadied when crowded by REZEKI (Apprentice P N Wong) which shifted back in.  Apprentice Wong was advised to exercise more care.  Between the 300 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of ABSOLUTE HONOUR.
Raced keenly throughout the middle stages.  Near the 1000 Metres was steadied to avoid ABSOLUTE HONOUR.
Jumped only fairly.  Approaching the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the inside of JOLLY BRILLIANT.
No report.

Bumped shortly after the start.  H Bowman stated that his mount travelled satisfactorily throughout the event and responded only fairly in the Home Straight which he attributed to the horse being up in weight for today’s race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  When commencing to finish the race off well over the concluding stages was steadied when crowded by INCREDIBLE MOMENT which was taken out by JOLLY BRILLIANT (D B McMonagle) which shifted out.  D B McMonagle was advised to exercise more care.

Bumped shortly after the start.  Raced keenly in the early stages and near the 900 Metres shifted out when steadied to avoid GORGEOUS VICTORY.  Near the 200 Metres Apprentice P N Wong dropped her whip.  Apprentice Wong stated that from a wide barrier she was instructed to ride the horse conservatively in the early stages to offset the wide draw.  She added that REZEKI finished the race off only fairly from back in the field.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings. <26/3/2026 Additional Veterinary Report>  REZEKI, which performed disappointingly, was examined by the Veterinary Officer who said at that time there were no significant findings. REZEKI was again examined by the Veterinary Officer at the stables of Trainer D J Hall this morning.  He said at this time he noted the horse to be lame in its left hind leg.  Before being allowed to race again, REZEKI will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
K Teetan stated that he was given the option of holding an on-pace position.  He said when his mount commenced well he was able to hold a more forward position than at its first race start.

C L Chau stated that from his wide barrier he was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and as a result his mount could not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Withdrawn on 21.3.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame left fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter CHILL PARTNERS.  Before being allowed to race again, LUCK SMILES will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Shifted in slightly shortly after the start and was bumped.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

When questioned regarding his riding in the Home Straight A Atzeni stated that he was instructed to hold his mount up in the early stages of the Home Straight as STAR RISE possesses a short sprint.  He said after following the favourite and the winner into the race he was content to remain racing behind that runner having regard to his instructions and also HOT DELIGHT was providing him with cover to continue to improve.  He added that after shifting to the outside of HOT DELIGHT approaching the 250 Metres STAR RISE lay in as it was placed under pressure.  Trainer D J Hall confirmed the instructions and the reasons as to why he issued those instructions.  The Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Atzeni were reasonable in the circumstances.

In the middle stages raced keenly.  Z Purton stated that after being placed into the starting gates his mount became fractious.  He said as a consequence COOL BOY was slow to begin which resulted in him settling towards the back of the field.  He added that in the Home Straight COOL BOY finished the race off well when placed under pressure.
Shortly after the start was hampered when bumped by HOT DELIGHT which shifted in slightly.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Jumped awkwardly.  In the early stages raced keenly and got its head up for some distance near the 900 Metres.

D B McMonagle stated that after settling back in the field his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, MICKLEY will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

He added in the Home Straight LITTLE PARADISE finished the race off only fairly and, in his opinion, may not have run out a strong 2000 Metres. Near the 1800 Metres improved to the inside of EMBLAZON as that runner was shifting in.  A short distance later BEAUTY BOLT was steadied when EMBLAZON was racing tight to the inside of SERAPH GABRIEL.  B Avdulla stated that the instructions were to go forward.  He said when his mount jumped awkwardly and then shortly after the start was crowded by LITTLE PARADISE it settled further back than intended.  He added in the Home Straight BEAUTY BOLT failed to run on when under pressure.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to have sustained a small cut to its left front leg.

C L Chau stated that his mount did not relax during the event when obliged to race wide and without cover.  He said as a result EMBLAZON did not run out the 2000 Metres of today’s race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 50 Metres PACKING FIGHTER improved into a tight run between LIVEANDLETLIVE and ENTHRALLED where it finished the race off well.

Shifted out abruptly at the start.  Near the 100 Metres made contact with SIX PACK, resulting in WINNING OVATION becoming unbalanced.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Prior to declaring weighed-in Trainer D J Whyte and Jockey K Teetan viewed the patrol films to ascertain if there were grounds for a protest/objection against WINNING OVATION being declared the winner.  When connections declined to lodge a protest/objection and the Stewards were satisfied that the contact between SIX PACK and WINNING OVATION (Y L Chung) near the 100 Metres was principally due to SIX PACK shifting ground and having regard to the manner in which both horses finished the race off, they declined to lodge a protest/objection and weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  At a subsequent inquiry Y L Chung and K Teetan were advised to exercise more care to prevent their mounts from shifting ground and making contact.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by WINNING OVATION which shifted out abruptly.
